what_it_does: Creates a compact, low-cost terahertz (extremely high-frequency electromagnetic) source operating at 232–260 gigahertz using standard CMOS fabrication. Most compact terahertz sources emit very little power; this design combines an amplifier-multiplier chain with a low-cost patterned dielectric matching sheet that improves the efficiency of radiating electromagnetic waves from silicon into free air. A matching sheet is far cheaper than silicon lenses while achieving similar performance improvements in power and bandwidth.
